# Semantic–Fiscal Gap Replication Package

[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9+-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/downloads/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.19290684.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19290684) 

This repository contains the complete, reproducible computational pipeline and econometric models accompanying the manuscript:

> **"The Semantic–Fiscal Gap in Circular Procurement: A Computational Econometric Audit and Governance Framework"** *(Submitted for Peer Review)*

To overcome strict government Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) regarding proprietary line-item public procurement pricing, this package provides a statistically engineered **Synthetic Twin Dataset ($N=1,420$)**. Generated via a Gaussian Copula model, this twin preserves the exact multivariate distributions, variances, and complex non-linear econometric relationships of the original empirical data while remaining fully open-source.

---

## 📂 Repository Structure

```text
Semantic-Fiscal-Gap/
│
├── data_raw/
│   └── synthetic_procurement_data.csv    # Generated synthetic twin dataset
│
├── data_processed/
│   ├── processed_dataset.csv             # Cleaned data with log transformations
│   └── panel_data_with_interaction.csv   # Final dataset ready for OLS regression
│
├── scripts/
│   ├── data_generation.py                # Gaussian Copula synthetic data generator
│   ├── preprocessing.py                  # Variable transformation logic
│   ├── semantic_gap_construction.py      # Computes the CIS x Digital interaction
│   ├── econometric_model_estimation.py   # Main Fixed-Effects OLS modeling
│   └── robustness_analysis.py            # HC1 standard error robustness checks
│
├── outputs/
│   └── tables/                           # Auto-generated regression output files
│
├── replication_run.py                    # Master execution script
├── requirements.txt                      # Python dependencies
├── LICENSE                               # MIT License
└── README.md
```

## 🚀 Quick Replication Guide

You can reproduce the entire methodology—from data synthesis to the final regression tables—in three steps.

**1. Clone the repository:**
```bash
git clone [https://github.com/aghiliarash/Semantic-Fiscal-Gap.git](https://github.com/aghiliarash/Semantic-Fiscal-Gap.git)
cd Semantic-Fiscal-Gap
```

**2. Install dependencies:**
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

**3. Execute the master pipeline:**
```bash
# First, generate the synthetic dataset
python scripts/data_generation.py

# Second, run the full econometric pipeline
python replication_run.py
```
*All final results, including the main regression output (`table2_main_regression_results.txt`), will automatically save to the `outputs/tables/` directory.*

---

## 📊 Econometric Model Specification

The core hypothesis is tested using a strict Fixed-Effects Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression with Heteroskedasticity-Consistent (HC3) standard errors. The model estimated in `econometric_model_estimation.py` is defined as:

$$\text{Fiscal Allocation (\%)} = \beta_0 + \beta_1(\text{CIS}) + \beta_2(\text{Digital}) + \beta_3(\text{CIS} \times \text{Digital}) + \gamma(\ln(\text{ProjectValue})) + \delta(\text{Type}) + \mu(\text{Region}) + \lambda(\text{Year}) + \epsilon$$

**Variable Definitions:**
* **Dependent Variable:** `fiscal_alloc_pct` (Percentage of BoQ allocated to circular clauses)
* **Independent Variable:** `cis_score` (Circularity Intensity Score)
* **Moderator:** `digital_mandate` (Binary: 1 if BIM LOD 350+ is mandated, 0 otherwise)
* **Interaction Term:** `interaction` ($\beta_3$ isolating the effect of digital verification)
* **Controls:** Project scale (`log_project_value`) and fixed effects for `building_type`, `region`, and `year`.

---

## 🔗 Dependencies
This pipeline requires **Python 3.9+** and utilizes the following core libraries:
* `pandas` & `numpy` (Data manipulation)
* `statsmodels` (Econometric modeling)
* `sdv` (Synthetic Data Vault for Gaussian Copula generation)
* `scikit-learn` (Validation metrics)
